title: Jailer 2 Posts Rs 404 Crore Worldwide in Four Days, Kollywood's Biggest Debut Ever
excerpt: The Rajinikanth sequel netted Rs 199.9 crore in India and USD 19 million overseas in its extended opening weekend, passing Jana Nayagan's lifetime total to become the highest-grossing Tamil film of 2026.
body:
• Jailer 2 grossed an estimated Rs 404 crore worldwide in its four-day extended opening weekend — the biggest debut in Kollywood history, ahead of Coolie's Rs 371 crore.
  • In India, the Rajinikanth starrer netted Rs 199.9 crore in four days (day-wise: 59.7, 37.1, 47.25 and 55.85 crore), Kollywood's second-biggest opening weekend ever behind 2.0's Rs 215.25 crore.
  • The film has passed Jana Nayagan's lifetime India total of Rs 198.57 crore to become the highest-grossing Tamil film of 2026 in just four days.
  • Overseas, it took USD 18.94 million, beating Leo's USD 18 million opening record; the Middle East (USD 6.68 million) and North America (USD 4.85 million across the US and Canada) led, and trade trackers see USD 25 million as certain with a shot at USD 30 million.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has turned its opening weekend into a record-breaking run. The Nelson-directed sequel grossed an estimated Rs 404 crore worldwide over its four-day extended weekend, according to Pinkvilla — the biggest debut any Tamil film has ever recorded, clearing the Rs 371 crore that Rajinikanth's own Coolie posted last year.

The India numbers

At the Indian box office, the film netted Rs 199.9 crore in four days, Koimoi reported, equal to about Rs 235.89 crore gross. The day-wise net figures show a film accelerating into Sunday rather than front-loading and fading: Rs 59.7 crore on day one, Rs 37.1 crore on day two, Rs 47.25 crore on day three and Rs 55.85 crore on day four, an 18.2% jump on Sunday. That total makes it Kollywood's second-biggest opening weekend in India, behind only 2.0's Rs 215.25 crore and ahead of Coolie's Rs 194.5 crore — four of the top five opening weekends in Tamil cinema history now belong to Rajinikanth.

Two records in four days

The weekend also rewrote the 2026 chart. With Rs 199.9 crore net, Jailer 2 has already passed the lifetime India total of Vijay's Jana Nayagan (Rs 198.57 crore) to become the highest-grossing Tamil film of the year — in four days. It is now Rajinikanth's fourth-highest-grossing film in India, behind 2.0 (Rs 407.05 crore), Jailer (Rs 348.55 crore) and Coolie (Rs 285.01 crore), and it passed Enthiran's Rs 165 crore on the way.

The diaspora markets carried the overseas record

Internationally, Jailer 2 grossed USD 19 million over the weekend, surpassing Leo's USD 18 million to post the biggest international opening for a Kollywood film. The Middle East was the standout territory at USD 6.68 million, and within it the UAE, where the film is already the biggest Kollywood release of all time after one weekend. North America contributed USD 4.1 million from the United States and USD 750,000 from Canada, with Malaysia (USD 2.25 million), the United Kingdom (USD 1.55 million), Australia (USD 990,000) and Singapore (USD 975,000) — the Tamil diaspora's core markets — all delivering strongly.

What happens next

The trend across the weekend matters more than the opening day: a Sunday bigger than the Saturday points to holds rather than a fan-driven spike. Pinkvilla's trackers see USD 25 million overseas as a certainty, which would itself be a new Kollywood benchmark, with USD 28-29 million a realistic target and USD 30 million possible if weekday holds stay robust. In India, the film enters the Rs 200 crore net club on day five, and the Rs 300 crore milestone is in reach within the week. All figures are trade estimates, not certified collections.
